crs.name: LOCAL:PARADISE_EQUIRECTANGULAR_M
crs.warning: This is a documented local grid, not EPSG:32610 or an official survey datum.

id_rule: P-{row:02d}-{col:02d}; row 0 is the southern edge, col 0 is the western edge

population.method: block-group population multiplied by the cell overlap fraction of the town-clipped block group
limitations: Area weighting assumes uniform population within each block group.
ACS estimates carry sampling error; the layer has no addresses or live occupancy.

roads.method: intersection length of road segments with each cell
limitations: 2025 geometry is not the 2018 evacuation network.
No closures, lane capacity, traffic speed or evacuation permission is included.
The 7x7 sample mesh is display-only and is not a modeling DEM.
Slope is a coarse derived value and must not be treated as surveyed terrain.

fuel.source: No LANDFIRE fuel layer is bundled.
fuel.method: documented default used by the transparent spread model
limitations: Fuel is not observed for any cell.

water.reason: No authoritative hydrant, tank or draft-site layer is bundled.

critical_facilities.reason: No authoritative critical-facility layer is bundled.

shelters.reason: Shelter locations and capacities are scenario assumptions, not official shelters.
